//: Committed on purpose. Everyone who clones this repo gets the same safety
control, and changing it is a reviewable diff rather than a local setting
The PreToolUse hook is what makes the README's claim true: the agent
cannot put a message in front of a person without a human approving it
first. Enforced in code rather than asked for in a prompt, because a
prompt is guidance and a hook is a control. Removing it does not just
relax a default — it makes the project's central promise false.
The deny rules draw the line under self-modification: the agent freely
edits its playbooks, schedules and CLAUDE.md — that is the product — but
never its own guardrails, the approval records, or the credential file.
